## Half-year periods {#fm3-half-years .fm-slide }

**8% p.a., compounded semi-annually** means:

$$\text{Rate per half-year}=\frac{8\%}{2}=4\%$$

$$18\text{ months}=3\text{ half-year periods}$$

::: {.takeaway}
Use **4% per period** for **3 periods**.
:::

::: notes
Preparation for Example 3.3. The stated annual rate is divided between the two compounding periods each year. Use 0.04 in the one-period interest calculation. Both the rate and the period count must change together.
:::
